pm_mode_enabled.meaning: Governor has enabled PM mode on the vault
pm_mode_enabled.checkpoint: before executeHedge() registers the supplied 0x811 slot

hedge_asset_whitelisted.meaning: Governor has whitelisted the hedge asset used by executeHedge()
hedge_asset_whitelisted.checkpoint: before executeHedge() registers the supplied 0x811 slot

supplied_slot_active.meaning: the 0x811 supplied slot is actually active on HyperCore at the time of the backing read
supplied_slot_active.checkpoint: before the strict backing read during settlement

settlement_halted.meaning: yield settlement halts (distributable surplus cannot be evaluated because the total backing read reverts)

assumptions: The supplied 0x811 slot is registered in the accountant by executeHedge() before HyperCore activates it.
The strict backing read (totalBackingSigned) is the operation that reverts when the slot is not active.
The operator is not modeled as malicious; the failure is internal self-poisoning.

unresolved.description: Report does not tie the totalBackingSigned() read to a specific transaction/checkpoint relative to slot activation, so the temporal ordering of the halt is only qualitatively stated.
Whether the slot is inactive at read time is conditional ('may not exist yet'); the scenario is potential, not observed.

limitations: Impact modality is potential; the plan encodes the report-supported conditional scenario, not an inevitable halt.
No numeric bounds or amounts are given for the supplied slot or backing values; the relation is qualitative.
Only the yield_settlement_halt impact is formalized here; other impacts are out of scope for this pass.
